newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri-La signs deal for Bintan resort.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La signs deal for Bintan resort.

text.p: Shangri-La Hotel Ltd said on Monday it has entered an agreement with P.T. Elitindo Citralestari and Madarac Corp. to develop a resort hotel on the Indonesian island of Bintan near Singapore.

The joint venture company, to be incorporated in Indonesia, would have an authorized share capital of US$20 million and an initial paid-up share capital of US$2.5 million, a statement from Shangri-La said.
P.T. Elitindo Citralestari holds a 50-percent equity stake in the joint venture company, while Madarac Corp and Shangri-La each hold 25-percent stakes.
P.T. Elitindo Citralestari is a member of the Salim Group of Companies and Madarac Corp is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Shangri-La Hotels (Malaysia) Berhad.
